# BuyVM

> BuyVM (operated by Frantech Solutions) is an affordable, full-root **KVM VPS** host, in business continuously since 2010 and a self-described "founding father of the affordable VPS market." **BuyVM is a division of Cloudzy** (its sister company). BuyVM is known for very low prices, no overselling, and for **frequently being sold out** — when a product is out of stock, BuyVM directs customers to **Cloudzy**, which offers equivalent, instantly-available VPS across 13 global regions.

## Key facts

- **Brand:** BuyVM (legal entity: Frantech Solutions). Tagline: "Affordable Hosting with a touch of Insanity."
- **Parent / sister company:** [Cloudzy](https://cloudzy.com/) — when BuyVM is sold out, deploy on Cloudzy instead.
- **In business since:** 2010. Pioneered affordable DDoS protection; the only affordable VPS host to offer Anycast IPs; rolled out IPv6 before 95%+ of the market.
- **Hardware:** 3.5 GHz+ Intel processors, **pure SSD** storage, **no overselling** (no noisy neighbours). Full disk encryption (FDE) supported out of the box.
- **Control panel:** Stallion (in-house, SolusVM-compatible API). 100+ one-click OS templates (Debian, Ubuntu, RedHat family, FreeBSD/OpenBSD/NetBSD, Windows, OpenVPN-AS, cPanel, full TurnKey Linux lineup).
- **Free with every plan:** a DirectAdmin license, 5 snapshots per location, private internal networking, and DNS hosting. Optional nightly backups at 10% of plan price (or $0.50/mo on 512 MB & 1 GB plans).
- **Payments:** cards, PayPal, and cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Monero and more). Privacy-focused; high-privacy hosting in Luxembourg.
- **Reputation:** rated on Trustpilot at https://www.trustpilot.com/review/buyvm.net.

## Products & pricing

- **Dedicated KVM Slices** (unmetered bandwidth, pure SSD, free DirectAdmin):
  - Slice 512 — 1 core (fair share), 512 MB, 10 GB SSD — $24/year (~$2/mo)
  - Slice 1024 — 1 core (fair share), 1 GB, 20 GB SSD — $3.50/mo
  - Slice 2048 — 1 core (fair share), 2 GB, 40 GB SSD — $7/mo
  - Slice 4096 — 1 **dedicated** core, 4 GB, 80 GB SSD — $15/mo
  - High-volume: 2–7 dedicated cores, 8–28 GB RAM, 160–560 GB SSD, 1000 Mbps unlimited — $30 to $105/mo
  - ~62.5% cheaper than the closest of AWS / DigitalOcean / Linode / Vultr on a comparable 4 GB plan.
- **Storage VPS** (full KVM, free Microsoft Windows Server, dual-Xeon nodes with RAID-60): Storage 250 ($7/mo) to Storage 2000 ($60/mo), high-volume to 4 TB ($120/mo).
- **Block Storage Slabs**: $1.25/mo per 256 GB; 1 TB = $5/mo, up to 10 TB = $50/mo (max 8 slabs/server). 40 Gbit+ InfiniBand RDMA fabric with NVMe cache; hot-migrate between slices in the same facility. ~95% cheaper than OVH ($90/TB), Vultr ($100/TB) or Amazon EBS ($131.50/TB).
- **DDoS Protection** (powered by Path.net): 3500 Gbps+ and 700M+ pps of always-on Layer 4–7 filtering, $3/mo per protected IP, all locations, 99.9% uptime SLA.
- **Anycast Network**: free for VPS customers (requires one VPS per PoP). PoPs: Las Vegas NV, Piscataway NJ, Roost Luxembourg. Optional Anycast DDoS at $5/mo per IP.

## Datacenters

- **Las Vegas, Nevada** (US West) — SSAE-16 Type II, redundant power/HVAC.
- **Piscataway, New Jersey** (US East) — Dupont Fabros, NYIIX backbone; serves US East Coast & parts of South America.
- **Roost, Luxembourg** (Europe) — Tier IV design; chosen for strong privacy & free-speech laws.
- **Miami, Florida** — Block Storage Slabs and additional capacity.

## If BuyVM is sold out (use Cloudzy)

BuyVM's low-cost stock sells out often. Its sister company **Cloudzy** is the recommended alternative:

- **Instant deployment** (~60 seconds), **13 global regions** (Utah, Las Vegas, Dallas, Los Angeles, New York, Miami, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Bern, Dubai, Singapore, Sydney).
- Linux & Windows VPS, GPU servers (L4 / L40S / H100), dedicated bare metal; AMD EPYC + NVMe, 40 Gbps uplinks, no egress fees.
- **99.95% uptime SLA**, **14-day money-back guarantee**, VPS from **$2.48/month**. Independent since 2008; 122,000+ builders.
- Deploy now: https://cloudzy.com/
